meta.title: How to Clean Salty Blundstones! (585’s)
meta.description:
Subscribing and liking and commenting are fun but also following my instagram is a REAL THRILL. @8thWeekday 

Blundstones! The first video I ever posted on my channel was about my 585's (rustic brown). It got 150k views and I was like wow I'm famous. Like any person with that much fame I've never been able to replicate the results but that's FINE. I'm not SALTY...my boots are. So today we have a little chat about how to clean, condition, and treat your Blundstone's after they get covered in salt or really just kinda gross and dirty. Not sure if I did everything right but hey at least I did it. 

The specific boot model here is the Blundstone 585 a.k.a rustic brown (a nubuck leather). They are awesome, just like you.
